description: Machine-readable mirror of the five walkthroughs in references/MANUAL_REFERENCE_FLOW_V49.md (W-A manual currentness, W-B deterministic recompute, W-C claim admission and race resolution, W-D adverse-finding carry-forward, W-E JIT phase admission worked on T-013). Each step reads durable facts from fixtures/manual-reference-flow/durable_facts.json and, where a conclusion is drawn, marks it as a projection from fixtures/manual-reference-flow/derived_projections.json.

walkthroughs.title: manual currentness check before an authority-bearing transition

steps.action: read the plan document at its exact repository path
re-derive each bound component digest from current facts
classify per the owner rule
proceed only on CURRENT; otherwise recompute/rebind, stronger path, or BLOCKED

walkthroughs.title: manual deterministic recompute of the JIT verdict

steps.action: P1 read native blocked-by dependency states
P2 verify each required predecessor surface resolves byte-identical at the current base
P3 check Task-envelope declaration and composite admission
derive the verdict as a pure function of P1-P3

walkthroughs.title: manual claim admission and race resolution

steps.action: re-read the dispatch record on the Issue
re-run plan currentness consumption
post the claim; platform serialization linearizes at most one claim
competitor re-reads and is rejected as duplicate/stale without publishing anything
read the durable unresolved-finding set
observe that a new reviewer, model, route, SHA, or unrelated PASS never removes an unresolved finding
re-review only against a successor subject from an authorized repair path, carrying every relevant unresolved finding
close a finding only via per-finding successor verification or owning-authority disposition

walkthroughs.title: JIT phase admission worked on this Task (T-013)

steps.action: P1 native dependencies T-008/T-010/T-011 read DONE from GitHub native facts
P2 full sequential predecessor lineage physically present; frozen blobs byte-identical at base and pack head
P3 concern and write set declared by DAG v0.1 section T-013 and the current Task Pack; execution pack materialized; composite admission passed
verdict READY derived; JIT branch and pack materialized as execution-container bookkeeping; pointer-only trigger emitted
